description: This is a unit test class for the SendThingMessage class in the Eclipse Ditto project, testing creation, serialization, deserialization, equality, and handling of messages related to 'sending' a Thing message.

classes.name: SendThingMessageTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SendThingMessage, testing various aspects including creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, and equality.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of SendThingMessage are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations.

methods.name: tryCreateWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating a message with null string thingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryCreateWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating a message with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryCreateWithNullMessage
methods.description: Tests that creating a message with null Message throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryCreateWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests that creating a message with null headers throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNonMatchingThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating a message with a mismatched ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryCreateValidMessage
methods.description: Tests successful creation of SendThingMessage with valid inputs.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toJson produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: toJsonWithEmptyPayloadReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies JSON output when message has an empty payload.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creation of SendThingMessage from valid JSON string.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJsonWithEmptyPayload
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON with empty payload.

methods.name: toJsonWithCustomContentType
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization when message has a custom content type.
